en_US.title: Packet Notary Interface Signatures
en_US.scanner: A packet seal can protect truth or bury it under custody delay.
en_US.field_note: The notary surface is useful because it names relay time, hash witness and custody owner in one place.
en_US.terminal: SIGNATURE SEED: Som Varela, Packet Notary Interface. Function: seals packet hashes, relay delay and custody status. Treat as evidence routing, not motive.
en_US.audio: A seal is not mercy. It is a clock with a price.
en_US.in_game_wiki: Packet Notary Interface signatures explain why some logs matter only after the player proves route, time and witness hash.
en_US.external_site: Packet Notary Interface signatures turn interstellar delay into legal evidence: relay time, hash witness, custody owner, and price.

ru_RU.in_game_wiki: Подписи Packet Notary Interface объясняют, почему часть логов важна только после доказательства маршрута, времени и witness hash.
